title: router ospf
desc: Enable OSPF routing and enter router configuration mode.

title: switchport mode trunk
desc: Set the interface to unconditional 802.1Q trunking mode.

title: show ip bgp summary
desc: Display the status of all BGP neighbors and prefix counts.

title: configure router bgp
desc: Enter the BGP configuration context for the base router (SR OS classic CLI).

title: show router
desc: Display BGP neighbor state and session summary on SR OS.

title: set network-instance
cmd: set / network-instance default protocols bgp autonomous-system <asn>
desc: Set the local AS for BGP in the default network-instance (SR Linux declarative CLI).

title: show network-instance
cmd: show network-instance default protocols bgp neighbor
desc: Display BGP neighbor state for the default network-instance on SR Linux.

title: create vlan
desc: Create a VLAN with the given name on ExtremeXOS.

title: configure vlan add ports
desc: Add tagged or untagged ports to a VLAN.

title: show ospf
desc: Display global OSPF configuration and operational state.
